changelog: fix: two QC modules were giving contradictory advice, and the reference-file check trusted filenames. (1) The merge-ceiling warning proposed 'truncLen = 250 - primer length' — on a real V3-V4 run that was 233/229 against a maximum of 226/223 that the app's own truncLen QC had measured from the same reads minutes earlier; following it would have discarded two thirds of the reverse reads. The measured maxima are now carried forward and used, the fallback arithmetic is labelled as an estimate, and when the ceiling cannot be raised at all the message says so instead of naming an impossible number. (2) Whether a reference is a trainset or an assignSpecies file is now read from its headers, not its name: a renamed assignSpecies file used to run for eight minutes and finish with no taxonomy and a confusing 'BIOM file not found', and a genuine *_toSpecies_trainset was rejected for having 'toSpecies' in its name. The wrong kind of file now stops the run immediately with an explanation. The Domain..Genus vs Kingdom..Species tie at depth 7 is also settled from the headers now — a trainset carrying species writes a binomial that repeats the genus above it — so a renamed reference no longer shifts every rank by one.

previous.2.8.3: fix: the read-direction token (_R1/_R2) was matched anywhere in a FASTQ filename instead of only at the end, so any sample whose own name contained R1/R2 was mis-parsed. 'Bacteria_R1_1.fq.gz' resolved to sample 'Bacteria
previous.2.8.2: fix: the PDF report kept reporting weasyprint as missing after it had been installed. The backend runs from its own venv (start.sh launches $APP_DIR/venv/bin/uvicorn), so a pip install typed at a cond
previous.2.8.1: add: single-run result report with QC, figures, a top-N ASV table and diversity; the merge-ceiling verdict now weighs read mass at the edge rather than using a fixed tolerance.
previous.2.8.0: add: PDF reports — report_builder.py, POST /report, and a 'PDF Report' button on each completed job.
